title: Great tour!
text: An absolutely wonderful Barcelona walking tour! Hengameh was warm, knowledgeable, and engaging, and she brought the city’s history, architecture, and culture to life. She showed us beautiful places we might otherwise have missed and tailored the experience to our interests. It felt more like exploring Barcelona with a knowledgeable local friend than taking a typical tour. My son and I thoroughly enjoyed our time with her and would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Barcelona
author: georginen2018

title: Hengameh is a Wealth of Knowledge
text:
Our walking tour led us through old Barcelona with our private tour guide Hengameh. What a collection of knowledge she has. She talked about the architecture of the old and new buildings and was able to answer any question my wife and I had. My biggest takeaway was the Roman influence on the city. She showed us a remaining Roman aquaeduct, Roman pillars, old castles, etc.
This tour was well worth the time/money spent.
author: TLCTimFL

title: Perfect Barcelona Walking Experience
text:
We had a really great experience exploring Barcelona with Hengame. She was warm, easy to talk to, and clearly very knowledgeable about the city’s history and culture.

The tour was well-paced and took us through some fascinating spots in the Gothic Quarter that we probably wouldn’t have discovered on our own. What we liked most was how she explained things in a simple and engaging way, without making it feel like a lecture.

title: Best part of our trip to Spain, Barcelona with Hengame.
text:
We had a really great time on this tour. Hengame was friendly, patient and easy to talk to. She explained things in a simple and interesting way, not boring at all.

We visited some beautiful spots in the Gothic Quarter and also places we would never find by ourselves. She also gave us good tips for food and local places. Highly recommend this tour!
